{{Otheruses|unidentified Abyssin}}
{{Conjecture|legends}}
A '''tribe''' of [[Abyssin/Legends|Abyssin]] voluntarily contributed genetic material to [[Kirgalis Pharmaceutical Exports]] to create the [[Abyssin grafting patch]], a medical technology employing regenerative cells to heal damaged tissue. They were the only source to have formed such an agreement, and, due to the potential future discontinuation of the tribe's partnership with the manufacturer and the general hostility of Abyssin tribes to off-worlders, [[Galladinium Galactic Exports]] recommended their customers to stock up on the grafting patch in case supplies became difficult to obtain in the future.<ref name="GFT">''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]''</ref>
